_comment: Same seventeen section-landing tile descriptions for the six non-Latin-script packs. Each honesty tail is the pack's own measured rendering from _probe_clause_tails.py: ar 'ليست Met وليست معتمدة.', he 'לא Met ולא מוסמך.', ja 'Met でも認定でもありません。', ko 'Met도 인증도 아닙니다.', zh-Hans '不是 Met 或已认证。', zh-TW '不是 Met 或已認證。'. Every pack keeps Met as a literal Latin status token, matching what those packs already ship. Latin identifiers (SHA-256, WORM, EDR, SSH, Agents) stay Latin rather than being transliterated -- that transliteration is the German-pivot defect repaired earlier in this pass. zh-TW uses Traditional glyphs only and the terminology settled earlier today: 認證資料 for credentials (not 證書, which is a diploma/X.509 certificate) and 提升權限 for privilege elevation (not 海拔/高程, which are topographic height). zh-Hans uses Simplified. Drafts need native review.

source.sectionLanding.desc.secure_program_launc: Launch applications with vaulted passwords, SSH keys, or certificates without showing the secret. Entitlements control which app may use which credential.

source.sectionLanding.desc.evidence_intake_pe: Visitor-log and escort procedure records. An attestation is not Met and is not certified.
source.sectionLanding.desc.evidence_intake_sr: Supplier questionnaire and signed flow-down records. An attestation is not Met and is not certified.
source.sectionLanding.desc.evidence_intake_mp: Witnessed-destruction procedure records. An attestation is not Met and is not certified.
source.sectionLanding.desc.supplier_register: Named suppliers with recorded scope and an assessment cycle. A register row is not Met and is not certified.
source.sectionLanding.desc.personnel_screening: Onboarding, offboarding, and periodic screening schedules with completion records. Not Met and not certified.
source.sectionLanding.desc.tabletop_exercises: Scheduled tabletop or practical exercises with participation records. Not Met and not certified.
source.sectionLanding.desc.scheduled_maintenanc: Local and nonlocal maintenance events with approval and escort attestation. Not Met and not certified.
source.sectionLanding.desc.contingency_drills: Scheduled facility or contingency drills with after-action hashes. Not Met and not certified.
source.sectionLanding.desc.assessment_engagemen: Penetration-test engagement records and remediation follow-up. The product does not perform the test. Not Met.
source.sectionLanding.desc.facility_access_revi: Facility-access review and visitor-cycle schedules. Installing doors stays with the organization. Not Met.
source.sectionLanding.desc.media_destruction: Witnessed destruction and degauss-certificate records. The product does not operate the shredder. Not Met.
source.sectionLanding.desc.retention_records: Retention attestations and export-delivery hashes. Operating WORM storage stays with the organization. Not Met.
source.sectionLanding.desc.posture_exceptions: Endpoint-coverage exceptions and posture reviews. The product does not run enterprise EDR. Not Met.
source.sectionLanding.desc.catalog_changes: Local log of control-catalog and mapping byte changes. Due-diligence evidence, not Met.
source.sectionLanding.desc.agents_download: Download Agents and settings files for this instance. Inventory and required-state validation for the operating package in effect — not Met.

ar.sectionLanding.desc.scheduled_maintenanc: أعمال صيانة محلية وغير محلية مع الموافقة وإقرار المرافقة. ليس Met وليس معتمدًا.
ar.sectionLanding.desc.contingency_drills: تمارين مرافق أو تمارين طوارئ مجدولة مع تجزئات تقارير ما بعد التمرين. ليس Met وليس معتمدًا.
ar.sectionLanding.desc.assessment_engagemen: سجلات مهام اختبار الاختراق ومتابعة المعالجة. المنتج لا ينفّذ الاختبار. ليس Met.
ar.sectionLanding.desc.facility_access_revi: جداول مراجعة الوصول إلى المرافق ودورات الزوار. تركيب الأبواب يبقى من مسؤولية المؤسسة. ليس Met.
ar.sectionLanding.desc.media_destruction: سجلات الإتلاف بحضور شاهد وشهادات إزالة المغنطة. المنتج لا يشغّل آلة التمزيق. ليس Met.
ar.sectionLanding.desc.retention_records: إقرارات الاستبقاء وتجزئات تسليم التصدير. تشغيل تخزين WORM يبقى من مسؤولية المؤسسة. ليس Met.
ar.sectionLanding.desc.posture_exceptions: استثناءات تغطية نقاط النهاية ومراجعات الوضع الأمني. المنتج لا يشغّل EDR للمؤسسات. ليس Met.
ar.sectionLanding.desc.catalog_changes: سجل محلي لتغييرات البايتات في كتالوج الضوابط وفي التعيينات. دليل على بذل العناية الواجبة، وليس Met.
ar.sectionLanding.desc.agents_download: نزّل برامج Agents وملفات الإعدادات لهذه النسخة. جرد والتحقق من الحالة المطلوبة لحزمة التشغيل السارية، وليس Met.
